name: Queen of Hearts

gender_note.quote: “Idiot!” said the Queen, tossing her head impatiently

base_age_note.reason: Not stated; a matronly reigning queen and mother of the royal children (ch008-p11).

hair.color: jet black with a streak of grey at one temple
hair.style: scraped back severely from a centre parting into a tight, heavy coiled bun beneath the crown
hair.reason: Not described; a hard black frame for a face that turns crimson and purple, and a strong silhouette against the red livery.

eyes.shape: small, hard, glaring under heavy dark brows
eyes.quote: after glaring at her for a moment like a wild beast

skin.tone: florid, high natural colour that floods crimson and then purple when she rages
skin.quote: The Queen turned crimson with fury / said the Queen, turning purple

features: heavy dark straight brows that knit into a scowl
face.default_expression: scowling, arms folded; a thunderstorm frown
face.quote: with her arms folded, frowning like a thunderstorm
face.reason: Frown and folded arms sourced; facial structure designed.

build.body_type: tall, broad, heavy and imposing; stamps when she walks
build.scale_reference: about 1.3x Alice's true size (135 cm); the tallest figure in the Hearts court and a head taller than the King
build.quote: shouted the Queen, stamping on the ground as she spoke
build.reason: Height not stated; designed to physically dominate the court and the King.

marks.description: a stylised gold crown with a red heart at its front
marks.reason: FAC-house-of-hearts emblem_visual ('crown devices for the King and Queen').

marks.description: spectacles, put on to stare at witnesses
shrill, loud 'voice of thunder' — no weapon ever; she rules by voice alone

default_outfit_tone.summary: crimson and white card-suited court gown: a stiff, flat, rectangular crimson front panel piped in white with a large red heart device on white at the chest, a full crimson skirt over a wide crinoline, gold crown
default_outfit_tone.silhouette_1862: 1862 court crinoline gown with a rigid flat front (a playing card worn as a tabard), squared shoulders; she moves and stands flat-on to camera like a court card
default_outfit_tone.reason: Hearts suit sourced (ch008-p11 'THE KING AND QUEEN OF HEARTS'); flat card styling per SUP-004 and FAC-house-of-hearts emblem_visual. Costume detail by 06-art/costume.

touches: flat rigid rectangular card-front tabard with heart pip
square-on, frontal blocking and stiff posture
performer_coding.limits: human performer, no painted-card body suit, no CGI flattening (SUP-002/SUP-004); no weapon, and no beheading is ever carried out (SUP-014)

prompt_base_en: a tall, broad, imposing English queen of about fifty in 1862 court dress styled as the Queen of Hearts playing card, jet-black hair scraped into a tight bun under a gold crown with a red heart, small hard dark eyes under heavy scowling brows, florid red complexion, square heavy jaw, stiff flat crimson-and-white card-front tabard with a large red heart over a full crimson crinoline skirt, arms folded
